{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= GUI Control

|descr= Returns the current state of given [[CT_CHECKBOXES]] control. Since Arma 3 v1.72 it is possible to query multiple checkboxes by providing checkbox index. For more information see [[CT_CHECKBOXES]].{{Feature|informative|The {{hl|"CheckBoxesSelChanged"}} control EH returns the control, index of changed checkbox and its current checked state. The checked state however is not a [[Boolean]] but [[Number]] 0 or 1. To convert [[ctrlChecked]] command output into number as well, use [[parseNumber]] command}}

|s1= [[ctrlChecked]] control

|p1= control: [[Control]] - [[CT_CHECKBOXES]] control. If control contain multiple checkboxes, only checkbox with index 0 is queried.

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] checked, [[false]] unchecked

|s2= control [[ctrlChecked]]  index

|s2since= arma3 1.72

|p21= control: [[Control]] - [[CT_CHECKBOXES]] control
|p22= index: [[Number]] - checkbox index

|r2= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] checked, [[false]] unchecked

|x1= <sqf>ctrlChecked _control;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_control ctrlChecked 3;</sqf>

|seealso= [[ctrlSetChecked]] [[cbChecked]] [[cbSetChecked]]
}}
